operations.conditions: Serialized local CPU; no paid API/LLM judge. Retrieval includes query encoding/loading/SQL/freshness, excludes reranker. LLM timer surrounds generate; generation stage also includes budgeting/loading/validation; timings are not additive.

conditions: Assistant manual required-fact/atomic-quote-block review, not independent human review. Development results do not estimate held-out accuracy. Full answers, source text and model traces are Git ignored.
